item.title: Viral Video: Sikh Men Denied Entry at Zudio Store in Manipur Over Kirpan, What the Law Says
item.description: A viral video from a Zudio store in Imphal, Manipur, has sparked debate after Sikh men were asked to remove their kirpans to enter. Citing Article 25 of the Constitution, the men refused, leading to a heated argument with management over religious freedom. While some support the store's safety rules, others decry it as religious harassment.

item.title: Arvind Kejriwal Breaks Down After Court Gives Him Clean Chit in Delhi Excise Policy Case, Says ‘Truth Wins’ (Watch Video)
item.description: AAP national convener and former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal broke down after being discharged in the Delhi Excise Policy case by the Rouse Avenue Court. Addressing the media, Kejriwal said the BJP had accused AAP leaders of corruption for years, but the court dismissed all charges and discharged all the accused.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal Hiring Engineers for Neuroscience Startup Temple With Strict Fitness Criteria for Applicants; Check Name of Roles
item.description: Zomato co-founder Deepinder Goyal announced a hiring drive for Temple, developing an elite athlete wearable using BCI, neural decoding and embedded AI. The firm seeks highly fit engineers and neuroscientists, urging applicants to meet strict body-fat targets and apply via email, underscoring India’s growing neurotechnology ambitions.

item.title: Business News | PM Modi Outlines Policy Roadmap for Developed India at Post-Budget Webinar
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed a post-budget webinar on "Technology, Reforms and Finance for Viksit Bharat" today, characterising the national budget as a long-term policy roadmap rather than a short-term trading document. The Prime Minister emphasised that every budget serves as a step toward the larger goal of "constructing a developed India by 2047."
